notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.body: That link does not point at a match.

update.title: Update available
update.body: Reload to pick up the newest version. Your matches are safe.

install.title: Install Pimpom
install.body: Open it like any other app, without hunting for the tab.
install.bodyNotify: Get a notification when it's your turn, and open it like any other app.
install.iosSteps: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

notifications.off: Notify me when it is my turn
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings
notifications.failed: Could not change the notification setting.

nickname.tooLong: Nickname must be {{max}} characters or fewer.
nickname.controlCharacters: Nickname must not contain control characters.

gate.tagline: Async games with your coworkers. One move at a time, no scheduling.
gate.label: Pick a nickname
gate.footnote: No password. Your nickname is your account — type the same one on any device to find your matches waiting.
gate.failed: Could not sign in — try again.

profile.trigger: Signed in as {{nickname}}. Profile and settings

rename.label: Nickname
rename.hint: Renaming keeps your matches and your record.

hub.noMovesNeeded: Nothing needs your move. Pick a game and start one.

empty.yourTurn: Nothing needs your move right now. Start something above.
empty.waiting: No matches waiting on someone else.
empty.open: No public lobbies are looking for players right now. Flip the switch above to Public match to host one.

reset.label: Reset your record
reset.title: Reset your record?
reset.body: Played, won and finished start again from zero, counting only matches started from now on. Every match stays in your lists — nothing is deleted.

daily.sectionHint: The same board for everyone, one run each. A new one every day at midnight UTC.
daily.loadFailed: Failed to load today's daily challenge.

tile.label: {{game}}, today's daily challenge. {{status}}
tile.fresh: Same board for everyone. One run a day.
tile.noScores: No scores on today's chart yet.

start.title: Today's board
start.body: Everyone plays the same board today, and you get one run at it. When your run ends, its score goes on today's chart.

end.title: End today's run?
end.body: Whatever the run has scored so far goes on today's chart, and there is no second run until tomorrow.

result.title: Today's run is over
result.rank: That's #{{rank}} of {{count}} on today's chart so far.
result.unranked: It ended without a score to rank.

daily.dayOver: That day's board has closed, and your run went on its chart as it stood.
daily.moveFailed: A move didn't go through. The board shows where your run really is.

chart.title: Chart
chart.label: Chart for {{day}}
chart.empty: Nobody has finished today's run yet.

match.notAPlayer: This match is already under way and you are not one of its players. Ask for a link to the next one.

share.title: Invite your crew
share.body: Share this code — anyone with it can drop in.

hint.private: Invite only — people need the code to join.
hint.public: Listed under Public on everyone's hub, so anyone can join. Comes off after a day with nobody joining.

visibility.failed: Could not change who can join.

lobby.waitingForHost: Waiting for the host to start.

history.title: History
history.timedOut: Time ran out — the round was resolved automatically
history.draw: The match ended in a draw
history.noWinner: The match ended with no winner

errors.no_identity: Your session expired — sign in again.
